## Headers

- [OnlineResourceMonitor.h](OnlineResourceMonitor.h): The OnlineResources registry as a list: every resource declared or fetched, whether it is on disk and how big, and for one in flight a progress bar that keeps moving. (declares `OnlineResourceMonitor`)
- [OnlineResourceMonitorWindow.h](OnlineResourceMonitorWindow.h): The monitor as the whole of a component tree: a host with it as the root and the stock UI face set, for an app that hands a window's content view to it and nothing else. (declares `OnlineResourceMonitorHost`, `OnlineResourceMonitorWindow`)
